episodes.synopsis: Masamune and Aki's class goes to France for their school trip and there, they meet an aspiring manga artist named Muriel.
episodes.title: The Wee Parisian Mademoiselle

episodes.synopsis: Aki tells Masamune about her past, but Masamune realizes that somehow, they remember a pivotal moment in their lives very differently.
episodes.title: The Princess's Confession

episodes.synopsis: Gasou tries to get closer to Aki, and Masamune confronts Yoshino about something.
episodes.title: They Show Up When You Least Expect It

episodes.synopsis: Yoshino tells Masamune exactly what happened in their past and then convinces him to stop Gasou from getting too close to Aki.
episodes.title: I'm Not Going to Fall in Love with You, Pig's Foot

episodes.synopsis: Masamune interrupts Aki and Kanetsugu's date by saying he's the Masamune Aki had met 8 years ago and ends up asking her out. Surprisingly, Aki ends up saying yes and the two formally become a couple, but Masamune can't help but feel conflicted…
episodes.title: So We Became a Couple

episodes.synopsis: Masamune and Aki go on their second date on Christmas Eve, which happens to be Aki's birthday as well, but...
episodes.title: Our Second Date

episodes.synopsis: After ruining his Christmas Eve date with Aki, Masamune tries to get some answers as to why he keeps breaking out in hives around Aki.
episodes.title: There's No Point in This Confession

episodes.synopsis: Masamune helps Yoshino after she sprains her ankle, and Aki meets with Gasou.
episodes.title: There Are Things You Shouldn't Realize

episodes.synopsis: Valentine's day is on the horizon and Yoshino offers to help Aki with making something for Masamune. Afterward Aki and Masamune go out on a date.
episodes.title: Saint Valentine Is Watching

episodes.synopsis: Aki invites Masamune out on a White Day date but it ends up going in a very unexpected direction.
episodes.title: Whiteout

episodes.synopsis: Masamune has had a series of absences from school, so Yoshino decides to check in on him after school. Chinatsu reveals that he's left and is staying with their grandfather in Shinsu.
episodes.title: Face Your Feelings

episodes.synopsis: What is the ultimate fate that awaits Masamune, Aki, and Yoshino?
episodes.title: Dead or Love?
